summary: Self-relative string copy: computes the delta between a2 and this, then copies the byte string from this to this+delta until the null terminator. Returns the last copied character (the terminator).

operations.description: Compute v2 = a2 - (char*)this, the self-relative offset from source to destination.
do { result = *this; this[v2] = result; ++this; } while (result); copies each byte including the null terminator.
Return result (the null terminator when the loop exits).

unresolved: Object semantics of the copy target (a2 relative buffer) are unknown; the destination may alias the same object as the source.
The prelabel template getter category is not applicable; actual behavior is a byte copy loop.
